# ITSM Operations Domain - API & Microservices Observability Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [ITSM Operations](../README.md)**

This directory contains observability and monitoring patterns for API and microservices within the **ITSM Operations Domain**. These patterns focus on monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, and operational excellence for service-based systems.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/itsm-operations/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Observability patterns for APIs and microservices address:

- **Distributed Tracing**: End-to-end request tracing across services
- **Logging**: Structured logging and log aggregation
- **Metrics**: Application and infrastructure metrics collection
- **Health Monitoring**: Service health checks and availability monitoring
- **Alerting**: Proactive incident detection and notification
- **SLA Monitoring**: Service level agreement tracking

| [PTN-OPS-API-003](./PTN-OPS-API-003-health-check-aggregation-pattern.md) | **Health Check Aggregation Pattern** | Aggregated health status across multiple services |
| [PTN-OPS-API-004](./PTN-OPS-API-004-structured-logging-pattern.md) | **Structured Logging Pattern** | Consistent structured log formatting and aggregation |
| [PTN-OPS-API-005](./PTN-OPS-API-005-metrics-monitoring-pattern.md) | **Metrics and Monitoring Pattern** | Application and business metrics collection and alerting |
| [PTN-OPS-API-006](./PTN-OPS-API-006-sla-monitoring-pattern.md) | **SLA Monitoring Pattern** | Service level agreement tracking and reporting |
